name: Microsoft Graph permissions
short_description: Microsoft Graph permissions, also called scopes, define what an app may access; delegated permissions let an app act for a signed-in user, while application (app-only) permissions let it act with its own identity, often requiring admin consent.

evidence.quote: In Graph, those permissions are called scopes. Think of them like a keycard.
Delegated permissions let an application act on behalf of a user.
The most dangerous permission type is application permissions.
